title: mesosphaerum lorentzianum
intro: Mesosphaerum lorentzianum, commonly known as Lorentz's mint or Indonesian mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its essential oil, which has been studied for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mesosphaerum lorentzianum include relieving digestive issues, reducing fever, and exhibiting antioxidant and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
